binding_gap: There is no formation hole to fix — every position is fillable and the eleven is legal as it stands. The binding constraint this cycle is not a gap in the squad but the transfer ceiling: the number of sales permitted equals the number of buys made, and the two bodies that could fund anything large are the same two committed to the move already in flight. That is what turns every other candidate on the board, including two genuinely good ones, into an affordability refusal rather than a merit refusal.
